title: APEX-NET deep learning diagnoses acute pancreatitis and grades severity on non-contrast CT
summary: APEX-NET segments the pancreas and diagnoses and stratifies the severity of acute pancreatitis on non-contrast CT, using feature mapping learned from paired contrast-enhanced CT. In 3383 patients from five centers, diagnosis AUC was 0.949 in validation, 0.958 internal, and 0.981 and 0.955 in two external cohorts. The abstract reports it outperformed a non-contrast CT model for severity and was compared with six radiologists.
ai_technology: Deep learning network with CT feature mapping from non-contrast to simulated contrast-enhanced features

evidence.tested: Three internal and two external cohorts, plus a six-radiologist reader study.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective and prospective data mix; severity AUCs not extracted from the truncated abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning segments the pancreas and predicts pancreatitis diagnosis and severity.
